svg.title: Worked example: one OODARIS decision, stopped at its approver
svg.desc: Worked example, drawn as a pipe that stops at a gate. 04:15: CL-03 is 6.8 percentage points under plan. 06:30: Move CL-03 to markdown ladder B, +$61,400 expected gross-margin dollars, reversible for 14 days. The gate is the approver. Approved by: Merchandise planning. Merchandise finance clears the margin limit. Past the gate the pipe is empty. It leads to price conditions in SAP S/4HANA for 214 SKUs, markdown ladder B for 18 doors in CL-03, and decision ledger entry 4417. By default, nothing is written back until someone approves.
svg.text: Move CL-03 to markdown ladder B
Merchandise finance clears the margin limit.
By default, nothing is written back until someone approves.
